method: Investigation only: new disabled-by-default paint scopes, original rendering algorithms retained. Sequential fresh offscreen processes; detailed wall-clock scopes are inclusive and cannot be summed. CSS ablations intentionally alter decoration and do not demonstrate a rendering-preserving fix.

initial_inline_detail.method: Sequential fresh offscreen processes; same immutable local CSS/font dependencies. Two return-to-theme cycles per process. Stage timings are not GUI event/display latency; detailed scopes are inclusive and cannot be summed. Images and sampled geometry/cursor hits are retained for before/after comparison. Full counter reference checked separately after timed stages.
